text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't have any grand dreams or anything, but hey, it's just plain fun seeing everyone amazed by my running~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll half-ass... I mean, reasonably do my best.
Let's both take it easy~.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
